# AI Feature Launch Plan — Horixon

## 1. Problem & promise
- User problem (one sentence):
- What the AI feature promises (one sentence):
- What it will NOT do:

## 2. Quality bar (evals)
- [ ] 30–100 real examples collected, with what "good" looks like
- [ ] Automatic checks (format, length, banned content)
- [ ] Human review rubric (1–5) and target score
- [ ] Failure cases listed and tested (empty input, long input, other languages, adversarial)

## 3. Guardrails
- [ ] Clear UI that it is AI; easy way to edit / undo
- [ ] Sensitive-data handling and logging policy
- [ ] Fallback when the model fails or times out
- [ ] Abuse / prompt-injection review

## 4. Cost & pricing
- Cost per request: ___ × expected requests per user per month = ___
- Included in plan / usage-based / add-on?
- Rate limits per user:

## 5. Rollout
- [ ] Internal dogfood (1 week)
- [ ] 5% of users behind a flag
- [ ] 50% → 100% if metrics hold

## 6. Week-one metrics
| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| Adoption (% active users who try it) | |
| Repeat use (used again within 7 days) | |
| Acceptance (outputs kept / used) | |
| Edits per output | |
| Thumbs-down rate | |
| Cost per active user | |
